scenarios.name: Modified Blob Bytes
scenarios.adversary_capability: Attacker mutates random bytes in published consensus blob sidecar
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Zstandard decompression integrity failure or KZG versioned hash mismatch
scenarios.residual_risk: Zero under assumption that client verifies KZG versioned hash and decompressor checksum

scenarios.name: Modified Canonical Payload
scenarios.adversary_capability: Attacker modifies 1 bit of canonical record stream after decompression

scenarios.name: Incorrect Metadata (Record Count Mismatch)
scenarios.adversary_capability: Publisher registers on-chain record count higher than actual records
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Record count mismatch during canonical stream deserialization
scenarios.residual_risk: None; client rejects publication if record count disagrees

scenarios.name: Omitted Record from Merkle Tree
scenarios.adversary_capability: Publisher drops 1 record from the dataset
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Merkle root calculation fails to match onchain recordsRoot
scenarios.residual_risk: None (Protected by Merkle tree leaf position binding)

scenarios.name: Reordered Records
scenarios.adversary_capability: Adversary permutes order of records without changing record contents
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Position-binding binary tree produces completely distinct root
scenarios.residual_risk: None (Strict leaf indexing enforced in MerkleLib.sol)

scenarios.name: Missing Blob in Multi-Blob Dataset
scenarios.adversary_capability: Network endpoint provides N-1 of N blobs
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Header validation checks blob_count against received sidecars
scenarios.error_details: Incomplete blob set; total blob count header mismatch
scenarios.residual_risk: Data unavailable if remaining blob is pruned

scenarios.name: Reordered Blobs
scenarios.adversary_capability: Adversary swaps blob indices during assembly
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Header blob_index field must match sequential chunk assembly order

scenarios.name: Duplicate Blob Insertion
scenarios.adversary_capability: Malicious peer delivers identical blob twice to disrupt reassembly
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Duplicate index detection in decoder stream assembler

scenarios.name: Partial Multi-Transaction Publication Abandonment
scenarios.adversary_capability: Publisher opens dataset, submits 1 of 5 transactions, and stops
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Dataset remains in Open state; cannot be finalized or attested as valid
scenarios.error_details: DatasetState remains Open; finalizeDataset reverts if blob count insufficient
scenarios.residual_risk: Gas spent on abandoned transactions cannot be recovered

scenarios.name: False Statistical Property Claim
scenarios.adversary_capability: Publisher posts false property claim (e.g. min > actual value)
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Permissionless challenger submits Merkle proof of violating record before deadline
scenarios.error_details: Claim transitioned to Refuted; challenger rewarded or claim invalidated
scenarios.residual_risk: Requires at least one honest challenger within the 18.2-day availability window

scenarios.name: Unavailable Sidecar (DDoS or Pruning)
scenarios.adversary_capability: Consensus clients prune sidecar or public RPC endpoints drop queries
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Explicit timeout and HTTP 404 / 410 detection by retriever
scenarios.error_details: Retriever signals BlobPrunedError; triggers fallback to Archival Bridge
scenarios.residual_risk: Data unavailable if not pinned in external archival backend

scenarios.name: Malicious Archival Backend Tampering
scenarios.adversary_capability: Compromised IPFS gateway returns forged bytes for requested CID
scenarios.detection_mechanism: SHA-256 and Content Hash check fails against Ethereum anchor
scenarios.error_details: Reconstruction assertion failure; forged payload rejected
scenarios.residual_risk: None; trustless cryptographic binding prevents acceptance of forged bytes

scenarios.name: Archival Identifier Substitution
scenarios.adversary_capability: Adversary tries to associate unrelated CID with dataset on ResearchArchiveRegistry
scenarios.detection_mechanism: Smart contract checks dataset finalization; clients verify CID contents match contentHash
scenarios.error_details: Binding verification failure during payload reconstruction
scenarios.residual_risk: Unrelated CID registration ignored if client cannot verify cryptographic content match

scenarios.name: Encryption Key Loss / Mismatch
scenarios.adversary_capability: Publisher encrypts payload with ephemeral symmetric key and loses key
scenarios.detection_mechanism: AEAD authentication tag failure during client-side decryption
scenarios.error_details: Decryption impossible without key; consensus integrity preserved but data unreadable
scenarios.residual_risk: Irreversible data loss if publisher loses private decryption key
